messages:
Maya Rao: Morning team — kicking off intake for NorthStar Labs pilot. They're ready to enroll 12 seats but want telemetry on usage + enablement in first 2 weeks.
Omar (NorthStar): Thanks Maya — we'll be sending one power user + 2 engineers to the pilot. Availability next Wed for kickoff.
Maya Rao: Great. @Jonas can you own telemetry tag setup and a quick dashboard? Need per-user token usage + latency by model.
Jonas Li: Yep, on it. I'll prepare a Grafana dashboard and a short data contract. Will drop the query and a curl example.
Priya Singh: I'll own the enablement agenda — 45m kickoff + 1hr hands-on. Recommend we include a prompt/cost demo and escape hatch for failures.
onboard-bot: Reminder: Pilot onboarding checklist — docs assigned to Maya Rao, infra tasks to Jonas Li, legal acceptance pending.
Jonas Li: Here's the snippet I'll share with NorthStar for instrumentation:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/events \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"customer":"northstar","user_id":"{{user_id}}","model":"redwood-v2","tokens":{{tokens}},"lat_ms":{{lat}}}'
```
Jonas Li: I'll also create tag `pilot_northstar` and a KPIs panel: total tokens, active users, p95 latency.
Maya Rao: Risk flag — they mentioned renewal concerns if seats aren't used in week 1. Let's plan a proactive escalation: Priya run weekly nudges + 1:1 with power user.
Priya Singh: A/B cadence: Day 2 check-in (task help), Day 6 adoption push (prompt library), Day 12 renewal conversation prep.
Omar (NorthStar): That cadence works. Can you also surface cost projections? We need to compare q4 run-rate vs expected pilot spend.
Jonas Li: I'll add cost per 1k tokens breakdown to dashboard and an export link.
Maya Rao: Action items: Jonas — dashboard + instrumentation doc by EOD Tue. Priya — enablement deck + schedule. I'll send invite for Wed 10am PT.
Priya Singh: Got it. I'll prep a 1-page 'what to do if LLM outputs unexpected' checklist.
Maya Rao: Thanks all. Putting this thread as the source of truth for the pilot intake. :sparkles:
